description.value: Walk-in campground on the scenic narrows of Shuswap Lake, offering 28 sites with potable water and washrooms in a sheltered lakeside setting; loaded touring bikes cannot be ridden directly to the sites from the parking area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website was successfully fetched but returned only generic BC Parks navigation menus and generic subpages (About, News, Reports, etc.) rather than the Cinnemousun Narrows park-specific page content, so no amenity details can be confirmed from web evidence. OSM tags confirm a fee-based, 28-capacity campsite operated by Silvertip Park Services Ltd. The OSM name 'Walk-In Campground' is direct positive evidence of walk-in access, strongly consistent with hiker/biker-style sites, and no other amenities can be verified beyond what the name implies.
concerns: The BC Parks website fetch returned only generic site navigation and subpages rather than the Cinnemousun Narrows park-specific page content; no amenity details could be extracted from the website. All optional amenities remain unverified.
Phone number (+1-250-320-9305) and email (parkinquiries@telus.net) could not be corroborated from the fetched website content.
No civic address is present in the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating BC Parks walk-in campground with confirmed OSM data and a live BC Parks website URL. Walk-in format makes it directly relevant to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM capacity tag lists 28 sites. Operator listed as Silvertip Park Services Ltd. in OSM tags.
